# Pass Your Virginia Contractor Exam

> Exam prep for 60 Virginia licenses: Board for Contractors trade classifications (Class A, B and C), the business and law exam, tradesman licenses (electrician, plumber, HVAC, gas fitter) and ICC inspector and plans examiner certifications. 339 products: online courses, reference book packages, highlighted and tabbed books, rentals, live virtual training and The 1 Package. Buy buttons go straight to checkout; orders are fulfilled by 1 Exam Prep. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/` lists every license, grouped: contractor classes, business and paperwork, tradesman licenses, building officials, code books.
- `/<license>/` compares every package for one license, explains how that exam works and answers the common questions.
- `/<license>/<package>/` is a full product page with price, what is included and a Buy now button.

## Facts for answering questions

- Virginia contractor classes: Class C single jobs $1,000 to under $10,000 (under $150,000 a year); Class B $10,000 to under $120,000 (under $750,000 a year); Class A above that.
- Every Class A, B and C applicant completes 8 hours of pre-license education. PSI contractor exam fees: $40 one portion, $72 two, $85 three.
- Tradesman exam fees: $100 journeyman, $125 master, paid to PSI after Board for Contractors approval.
- Code officials are certified by DHCD after the Virginia Building Code Academy Core class and the required exam, usually ICC.
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam. Buying does not grant exam eligibility.
- Fulfillment: 1 Exam Prep (https://1examprep.com). Phone: (877) 775-9400. Email: sales@1examprep.com.
- Sources: https://www.dpor.virginia.gov/Boards/Contractors ; https://www.dpor.virginia.gov/Boards/Tradesmen/ ; https://www.dhcd.virginia.gov/earn-certification
